resources.string: The faces that turn: the day, the phone, photos and weather, the web
Each face is something the tile can say. Switch on the ones you want and the tile turns through them, one after the other.
In what order, how fast, what comes first, plans by the hour
How the faces follow one another: their order, the speed, what must come first when it matters, and different faces at different hours.
Time zones, clock with hands, quick timers
How the time face looks: one or more time zones, hands or digits, a photo behind it, buttons for a timer.
Where the events and the weather come from: only some calendars, or the weather of another city.
Where the photos come from and the memories
Which photos the tile shows: an album, some you pick, the favourites; what to leave out; and how it looks for the photos of this day in past years.
Dots, colour, faces side by side
How the tile looks: dots that say which face is on, a colour that follows what it says, or several faces laid out together.
Hide what is written, Do Not Disturb, Wi-Fi, morning summary
What stays hidden from whoever looks at your screen, and what the tile does by itself: with Do Not Disturb, on a Wi-Fi network, away from home, with a morning summary.
Start from a model, pass on or import a choice, read it aloud
Ready-made choices to start from, a way to pass this choice to another phone as text, and a button that reads what the tile says aloud.
Time, events, alarm, week, countdown, timer, sun and moon
Battery, steps, music, what waits, things to do, people, a widget
Latest photos, memories, the weather, a chart, advice
Headlines and quotes: these read from the Internet

Which calendars the events come from
The city the weather is of
Album, photos you pick, favourites, what to leave out

Models, sharing, reading aloud, back to the start
The time and the date, or the time in the zones you choose in Time and zones. A touch opens the clock.
The next two events of your calendar, with when they begin (\"in 25 min\", \"now, until 15:30\"). Needs the calendar permission. A touch opens the calendar.
When the next alarm of the phone rings. It stays out of the turn when there is none.
The next seven days, with a dot on the days that have something on. Needs the calendar permission.
The day from 6 to midnight as a line, with a block for each event and a mark where it is now. Needs the calendar permission.
The days to a date you choose (a trip, a birthday, an exam), with its name.
Choose the day to count to and what to call it.
What is left of the timers of Start that are running or paused. It shows only while one goes.
When the sun rises and sets today, and the phase of the moon. Needs the city of the weather.
The charge, and how it is charging or how long it lasts. With Smart on, it only comes up when it is low or charging.
A graph of how the charge went in the last hours.
The steps of today with a bar towards your goal. Needs the physical activity permission.
The song, the artist and the cover of what plays in any app. It shows only while something plays. Needs notification access.
How many calls you missed and how many mails are unread. Shows only when something waits. A touch opens the phone.
How many things are open in To do and the first ones. Shows only when there is something.
The next reminders and how many are late. Shows only when there are some.
The next birthdays of your contacts. Needs the contacts permission.
The first lines of a note you choose: a code, a list, a place. Notes with the lock of the phone never show.
Choose the note the face shows.
The photos of your favourite contacts, one after the other. Needs the contacts permission.
Who wrote last in a chat, from the notifications that are up. It puts the text of messages on Start; \"hide what is written\" in the notifications settings leaves it out.
What an app publishes to its tile through the launcher\'s open protocol (title, line and number). Choose which app.
Choose the app whose words the face shows. Only apps that have published something are listed.
The street where you saved the car and how long ago. Shows only if a car is saved.
The mobile data used today and this month. Needs the usage access.
The apps you used most today. It shows what you do on the phone: leave it off if others look. Needs the usage access.
Four switches to touch: the torch, Wi-Fi, quiet hours and rotation. Best on a large tile.
An Android widget as one of the faces: the weather or sports widget you like, inside this tile. It uses the memory and the updates of the widget.
Choose the widget that is shown. Android may ask you to allow it.
The latest photos of the phone, of an album, or the ones you pick. Needs the photos permission. A touch opens the photo.
The photos taken on this day in past years, with \"3 years ago\" on them. Needs the photos permission. It stays out of the turn when there are none.
The weather now, the rain, the next hours and days of the city you set in the weather tile (or one of your own for this tile). A touch opens the forecast.
The temperature of the next 24 hours as a line, with the chance of rain as bars.
One line in words: take an umbrella, wear a jacket, drink. It shows only when the weather calls for it.
The latest headlines of the source set in the News app. It reads from the Internet while Start is on screen.
The quotes you follow (currencies, shares). It reads from the Internet while Start is on screen.
The faces that are on, in the order the tile turns through them. Touch the arrows to move one.
How long each face stays before the next: slow, normal or fast.
Each face for as long as it takes to read
A long event title stays longer than the time. Off, every face stays the same.
An event or an alarm within the chosen time, a low battery or rain about to fall stays alone on the tile. At night only the time shows.
Only what matters while saving battery
While the phone saves battery nothing turns: the tile shows the one face that matters most now.
An event or an alarm this near is what matters: 15 minutes to 2 hours.
From this hour to that one only the time shows. The end may be earlier than the start: the night goes through midnight.
The battery only when it matters
With Smart on, the battery face stays out unless it is low, charging or full.
Rain that is about to fall first
With Smart on, the weather face comes first and alone when it rains or will within the hour.
Faces by the hour of the day
From an hour on, the tile turns through other faces: the calendar and weather in the morning, photos and battery in the evening. Up to three.
Tie a face to a condition: the battery below a charge, an event within some minutes, rain, charging, or not between two hours.
One or more cities for the time face. With two or three it lists them; with none it is the time of the phone.
The time as a clock with hands. Only for the time of the phone, with no other zone.
Three buttons, 5, 10 and 15 minutes, on the time face: the clock app starts the timer at once.
One of the tile\'s photos behind the time, darkened to keep the numbers readable. Needs the photos permission.
Only the calendars you choose: one tile for work, another for the family. By default all of them.
The weather of another city for this tile (the city is followed, up to five, so its weather is read). By default the city of the weather tile.
The album the photos come from. By default the latest photos of the phone.
Choose the photos yourself, up to 24. The tile can read only those; no photos permission is needed.
Only photos marked as favourites in your gallery (Android 11 and later; not every gallery marks them).
Screenshots are not shown on the tile, nor among the memories. Off by default: they are photos of the phone like the others.
Albums whose photos never show on this tile: chats, scans, anything private.
When there are no photos of this exact day, look this many days either side. 0: only this day.
Small dots in the corner: how many faces there are and which one is on. Touch them to go to the next.
Colour that follows what it says
The tile turns red when the battery is low, blue when rain is about to fall, dark at night. A colour you gave the tile wins.
On a wide or large tile, lay the time and what the tile says side by side instead of turning.
The tile says \"event\" and the time, not what it is: for whoever sees your screen.
The photo faces stay dark and say only how long ago: the pictures never show on Start.
Only time and weather in the Kid\'s Corner
In the Kid\'s Corner the tile shows only the time and the weather, nothing of your calendar or photos.
While Do Not Disturb is on, the tile shows only the time and the alarm.
When the time zone of the phone is not that of your home, the time face also shows the time at home.
On the network you name (your home), the tile turns through other faces. Android gives the network name only with the location permission.
While a Bluetooth audio device is connected (the car, headphones), the tile turns through other faces.
At the hour you set, one notification with what the faces say: events, alarm, weather, things to do. Nothing runs in between.
Ready-made choices: morning, travel, night, essential or the usual three faces. It replaces what the tile is set to now.
Sends this choice as a short text. It holds the faces and the switches, not your albums, notes, networks or photos.
Paste a text shared from another phone. It replaces what the tile is set to now.
Says in words what the tile holds now: time, next event, alarm, weather, battery. The speech engine of Android does it; nothing leaves the phone.
The time, the events and the photos, as a new tile has them. Everything else you set here is forgotten.
A small button on the photos of this day to send the photo with \"5 years ago today\". Nothing is sent until you choose who gets it.
No calendar found. Give the calendar permission first.
Five cities are followed already: choose one of them.
the city of the weather tile
That is not a choice of a tile.
the battery is below a charge
an event is within some minutes
Side by side (wide and large tiles)
A medium or small tile always turns.
Turning, one face at a time
Start from a ready-made choice. You can change everything afterwards.
No note to show. Notes with the lock of the phone are never listed.
No app has published anything to its tile yet.
Albums, notes, networks and photos stay on this phone.
Smart looks at the calendar, the alarm, the battery and the weather.
Nothing to show now: this face stays out of the turn until there is.
The permission is missing: this face stays out of the turn.
The usage access is missing: this face stays out of the turn.
Write the name of the network exactly as the phone shows it. Capitals do not matter.
Morning: time, calendar, weather, things to do
Travel: time at home, weather, calendar, photos
It is cold: wear a jacket
It is hot: drink and keep in the shade
Take an umbrella: rain is coming
